items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: you mentioned too that you made a mistake when you told about him playing on the mouthpiece at Tom Anderson's.

ctx.x: 1933. Well, you mentioned too that you made a mistake when you told about him playing on the mouthpiece at Tom Anderson's. Oh, yeah, yeah, Tom.

I said it was $10, and Mama said it's $25. $25. And she said in those days they had what they called the kitty. Mm-hmm. And they told him... That wasn't for the kitty, that was for him. That was for him especially. That was for him especially. That's why people put the tips at him.
